metadata.title: Exclude more interim contracts from ticket minting
metadata.description:
# Exclude more interim contracts from ticket minting
The protocol generates lottery tickets by taking into account the INT value purchased from the main uniswap 1% pool. First receiver of INT from pool is entitled to tickets. Sometimes the first (or even second) recipient is not the original buyer (user), but just an intermediary contract of an aggregator, arbitrage bot or other defi protocol. We have ability to eliminate such unwanted contracts from getting tickets by adding them to special excluded list.



**This Tally proposal** is for elimination of 8 such occasions found by observing past transactions. Below are listed contract addresses for elimination:

0x4f82e73EDb06d29Ff62C91EC8f5Ff06571bdeb29 - KyberSwap: fee collector

0xC7D3AB410d49b664D03Fe5B1038852ac852b1B29 - KyberSwap: Aggregator Executor

metadata.title: Approve config and fund TicketAutomator and ReferralStorage contracts
Fund Multisig for Coinpresso Marketing
metadata.description:
# Fund Multisig for Coinpresso Marketing
As we near the completion of upgrades to our Website, Ticket Automator, and Referral Contracts, INT is all but ready to start its first marketing campaign.

Based on the in-depth research shown [here ](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TqAi7wODLecOX7MxImL0x8Fo1ZcB4Je7co9gD_h_wJ8/edit?usp=sharing "here")as well as internal discussions within the group of multisig signers, we believe Coinpresso is the clear choice for INT's first marketing campaign.

This proposal is to clear the approval of $23,000 to be used for the first month of marketing with Coinpresso ([details here](https://pages.qwilr.com/Web3-Marketing-Strategy-Internet-Token-w7ms6VZeRcuH "details here")) and fund the multisig with appropriate funds.


Recognizing the requested amount is relatively large for INT's treasury, we plan on being very critical of the results. Our baseline expectation is for the treasury to recoup approximately 50% of marketing expenses via tickets generated directly from campaign ads. We believe this would be an acceptable initial result, as many new lottery participants would likely become return players, creating a compounding month-to-month effect. If this marketing campaign fails to recoup ~50% of its cost, the multisig team will re-evaluate our opinion on continued work with Coinpresso.


The multisig wallet currently holds $9,563 in USDC and is in need of at least $13,500 (~5 WETH) to complete payment. To account for potential market fluctuations, this proposal requests 6 WETH in order to ensure multisig will have enough funds for its first month of marketing.

metadata.title: Exclude Kosher Capital interim contract
metadata.description:
# Exclude Kosher Capital interim contract 
With marketing just around the corner it's important that we "fix" the issue of the INT token going over 24 hours without any notable volume, hence making it "invisible" via normal dexscreener search. The lack of volume also presents a trust problem to new investors and could create friction during new investor/lottery player acquisition.


One solution I have begun to test is Kosher Capital's "Trading Agent", a bot capable of functioning as a market maker or high-frequency trader. With the proper settings and funding I believe this trading agent can act as a pseudo-market maker + "ticket farmer", either for individuals or as a protocol owned bot. This capability would also present a strategic opportunity for mutually beneficial collaborations with Kosher Capital (if they'd like), such as sponsoring "trading competitions" for INT-trading agents.


Initial testing has gone well, including the ability to retrieve NFTs from the agent's wallet. Though currently there is an intermediary contract that all agents use to facilitate swaps, awarding the contract weekly tickets instead of the agent itself.


I would like to exclude this contract from being awarded fees so that I and/or others can perform more robust testing to achieve a true proof of concept while simultaneously helping INT's volume become more consistent.

metadata.title: Funding Proposal for Contributor Payment Budget
metadata.description:
# Funding Proposal for Contributor Payment Budget
This proposal seeks DAO approval and transfer of funds to pay core and outside contributors for the further development of the protocol and variuos other management/marketing activities. As per discussions in chat channels and proposal on governance forum only INT tokens will be used for compensating contributors:

[https://gov.theinternettoken.com/t/contributor-payment-budget/73](https://gov.theinternettoken.com/t/contributor-payment-budget/73)

\---

**A maximum of 10M INT tokens per quarter limit will be imposed so 40M INT tokens budget should cover the costs for at least a year ahead**. Preliminary estimates for the first quarter of 2025 are less than 5M INT.

Funds will be transferred to operational multisig wallet for further redistribution as needed:

[https://app.safe.global/home?safe=base:0x0C02d2D320C62d4088840a459fE8862C802fbA78](https://app.safe.global/home?safe=base:0x0C02d2D320C62d4088840a459fE8862C802fbA78)

metadata.title: Reduce voting period to 3 days
metadata.description:
# Reduce voting period to 3 days
The current voting period is set to 6 days. Adding 1 day for pending and 1 day for execution of the proposal, it takes a total of 8 days to pass any DAO changes or actions.  **This proposal is to shorten the voting period to 3 day**s, leaving other params intact (so full voting cycle will take 5 days).



P.S. Either way, there are only a few active voters at the moment, and the old params can be reverted at any time if necessary.

metadata.title: IFT staking campaign extension for another 50 weeks
# IFT staking campaign extension for another 50 weeks
metadata.description:
# IFT staking campaign extension for another 50 weeks
The IFT staking rewards introduced at the beginning of the year proved to be a success. 80 Lucky Hand IFTs were minted since the start of the campaign, but only -12 were burnt. A further 44 custom IFTs were minted and only -18 were burned. As a reminder, more than half of the Lucky IFTs were burned before the staking was introduced, so it slowed down the IFT burning and INT dumping considerably. The initial staking campaign was mean to last 10 weeks and will end on 2025-03-12. This Tally vote is to extend the staking campaign at the same rate for another 50 weeks (~1 year). The longer period will signal to IFT holders the long term vision of the project and make IFT (INT) holding even more comfortable and desirable.



On successful vote 25M INT tokens will be transferred from treasury to RewardManager contract and after the funds will be added as staking rewards at 500k INT weekly rate for another 50 epochs (weeks) starting 2025-03-13. To let the protocol governor contract use necessary RewardManager's function it will be granted REWARD\_ADMIN role.



References:

RewardManager contract on base:

[https://basescan.org/address/0x19b30c4f5b86c3ec1334c0f96ce09f4071e2146f](https://basescan.org/address/0x19b30c4f5b86c3ec1334c0f96ce09f4071e2146f)

metadata.title: # Award Bounty for exclusion: 0x878f88451aa6489f7d78b26806ec32200a5a6e47
metadata.description:
# Award Bounty for exclusion: 0x878f88451aa6489f7d78b26806ec32200a5a6e47
Vote For, to award a bounty, if the account 0x878f88451aa6489f7d78b26806ec32200a5a6e47 was usefully excluded.

Usefully excluded refers to: The excluded account must be related to a frequently used DEX or aggregator,
AND exclusion of the account is necessary to avoid loss of tickets from regular user action,
AND the example transaction clearly demonstrates a user losing a ticket through regular DEX or aggregator usage.

Regular DEX or aggregator usage refers to: Usage of the DEX or aggregator in a way that matches the official interface.

Example Transaction: https://basescan.org/tx/0x81032466a1eebaa2ce19dc1e3e731e72d6e9c139dbff6bdb04eb354c7d5df68a

Remove PickCallbackV2 processor
Approve Chainlink VRF Provider
metadata.description:
# Approve Chainlink VRF Provider
INT protocol uses VRF providers for lottery draw random number generation. With [V2 upgrade](https://www.tally.xyz/gov/internet-token-dao/proposal/90446474918166121536156425568182495185255315196981939882626367416536657635688 "https://www.tally.xyz/gov/internet-token-dao/proposal/90446474918166121536156425568182495185255315196981939882626367416536657635688") new PythVrfProvider was deployed for the task. But this provider does not work properly as intended- after sending vrf request, fulfilling tx not happening automatically because of strict gas limit and the tx must be called manually. 



To fix the problem new VRF provider contract was deployed utilizing industry leading [Chainlink Verifiable Random Function](https://docs.chain.link/vrf "https://docs.chain.link/vrf") (VRF).



ChainlinkVrfProvider contract:

[https://basescan.org/address/0xe67bb67b50861748baffc88f35e2483fdac42a6e](https://basescan.org/address/0xe67bb67b50861748baffc88f35e2483fdac42a6e)



To use new VRF provider for lottery randomness we need to update RewardDistributor configuration with this Tally vote. Only vrfProvider value will be changed and all other configuration params will stay as is.



RewardDistributor contract:

[https://basescan.org/address/0x3688bcabf06a8d8ee4447ab1c045d67407881ea3](https://basescan.org/address/0x3688bcabf06a8d8ee4447ab1c045d67407881ea3)

metadata.description:
# Update wining odds and seed Progressive Jackpot
After a successful test of the renewed V2 contracts and winning the first Progressive Jackpot, we need to change the win odds and top up it with even bigger amounts.



With this vote the RewardDistributorV2 contract settings will be changed, reducing the odds of winning Progressive Jackpot to 10% (all other settings for contract remain unchanged). At same time 5 WETH and 5M INT will also be transferred from treasury to seed Progressive Jackpot. 



RewardDistributorV2 contract-

[https://basescan.org/address/0x3688bcabf06a8d8ee4447ab1c045d67407881ea3](https://basescan.org/address/0x3688bcabf06a8d8ee4447ab1c045d67407881ea3)



Since the Tally voting and it's execution takes 8 days, in order to be able to replenish the grand prize without delay immediately after the next Progressive Jackpot win, we are transferring additional 5 WETH + 5M INT to the Operational Multisig.



The multisig address on base is

[https://basescan.org/address/0x0c02d2d320c62d4088840a459fe8862c802fba78](https://basescan.org/address/0x0c02d2d320c62d4088840a459fe8862c802fba78)



It is a 4/7 multisig. You can view the multisig holdings and transactions on basescan.org or via the Safe website.



[https://app.safe.global/home?safe=base:0x0C02d2D320C62d4088840a459fE8862C802fbA78](https://app.safe.global/home?safe=base:0x0C02d2D320C62d4088840a459fE8862C802fbA78)
